generation.scope: For a twisted cubic point graph with disjoint finite residual, each six-point residual is scheme-isomorphic to a plane section of an explicit quadric and the three-by-three determinant. The cyclic tensor is the product of four binary edge diagonals and a four-qubit tensor. The canonical four-shift on the curve is either the identity or an involution: connected groups and all orders at least three are excluded.

open_mathematics: Analyze the two binary tensor rank-six cuts for the involution and identity. Use the residual plane complete intersection and finite Frobenius test to remove boundary components and prove AS criteria for remaining candidates.
